title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future — Episode1 A Thrilling Performance

meta.Event Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Line: Morinomiya Revue - Theatre

rows.Speaker: Swordsman
rows.Line:
“This swordsmanship...!
You are no mere ogre, are you?!”

rows.Speaker: Ogre
rows.Line: “Hah! I have long since forgotten about my past!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Whoaaa...!
Their swords are going all cling-clang-clash!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Their blades look like they're dancing, but they sound so solid whenever they meet.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is quite the spectacle...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (After learning more about sword fighting with Mikazukigumi, I have a much greater appreciation for just how difficult it is to move with such speed and precision.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The director must've put quite a lot of effort into making this scene feel so compelling.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (You can tell that the costumes are meant to flutter a certain way.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're also amazing singers. The all-female Suzurangumi troupe really wows you with their beauty and charm, while this one seems to be more about power and action...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There's more to it than just the fact that they're all boys. I mean, they're all performing at such a high level...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is so cool...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I didn't know Kikyogumi was so amazing...!!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooowww...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was an excellent performance...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. The scene at the end where the swordsman and the ogre part ways under the cherry blossoms... It was sad, but I like how they left room for them meeting again someday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I noticed a few people in the audience tearing up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In the beginning, they fought like only one of them would be left standing... I feel that the final scene was so moving because they presented us with such an epic battle.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Everyone in the audience really got to understand the swordsman and ogre's feelings!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (For some reason, there were a lot of empty seats...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Even though they put on such an amazing show.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, we've been talking for quite a while now. We mustn't overstay our welcome...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That being said, I'd love to discuss further. Why don't we all find a place where we can resume this conversation?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try the diner by the station?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sounds good. I could use a bite.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, then... Let's go!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew...
We really chatted up a storm.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Talking about all our favorite scenes was super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I also had fun.
It's been a while since we got to talk like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it has! After all, Rui and I are training with the boys, you're with the girls, Nene, and you've been learning all about management, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Speaking of which, what are you guys working on right now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tap dancing, until just recently.
We'll be having lessons on traditional Japanese dance soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys get to learn about so many different things!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How to put it... Things have felt a bit hectic lately.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For some reason, our teachers are constantly getting swapped in and out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nothing like that's been happening on my end. What do you think is going on...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We have no idea...
But I for one have been enjoying the chance to learn from so many different instructors.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Each one focuses on the aspects they see as most important. In other words, we get to tackle a subject from many different angles.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that is kinda nice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Just like taiyaki shops.
They're all really good, but also taste a little different!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That seems like an apt comparison.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What about you, Emu?
It seems like you're always doing something different. I remember you learning about being a producer one day and how to write proposals the next.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, lately, I've been learning a lot about budgeting for day-to-day operations.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All the stuff about employee wages and maintenance costs are things I've heard about when it comes to Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But Morinomiya puts a lot of resources into their props and costumes because they want their audiences to “experience the extraordinary”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
In other words, resources are allocated differently depending on what a company wishes to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah. It's been a lot to process, but I've also been having a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like you've been gaining quite a lot from this experience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Lots and lots of people at both Morinomiya and Phoenix Wonderland are working really hard to put smiles on everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Some problems are really, really hard to solve, and you sorta just have to take a leap of faith...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I wanna become somebody who can help solve those kinds of problems.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why I'm really enjoying what I'm doing right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, also!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The other day, when I was learning about administrative practices... Oh, wait!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...?
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So...
That just reminded me of something...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I saw this really strange girl the other day!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A strange girl? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, there's this really fancy room where the executives hold their most important meetings...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And this girl around our age came walking out of it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She was in their meeting room?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Was she there as an official participant...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's hard to believe that someone our age would be engaging with any executives.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu is a bit of an exception, and I feel that we would've heard about such a girl through word of mouth by now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe some of the other Morinomiya students could give us a clue...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This might actually be the perfect time...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... There's someone that I want you guys to meet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's a classmate and showed a lot of interest in our troupe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She might know something, so wanna try asking her?
